where: Section 2, average-pooling gradient paragraph and Exam traps bullet 5
problem: The rule 'each cell gets output gradient / (p × p)' is exact only for one non-overlapping window. If pooling uses stride s < p, windows overlap and an input cell receives the sum of contributions from every window that contains it. The text does not state this.
fix: Say: 'For one window, each cell in it gets g/(p × p). If windows overlap, add the contributions from every window that contains the cell.'

problem: 'the map shrinks by the same factor on each side' is not exact when the input side n is not divisible by the pool size p; the exact output side is given by the floor formula.
fix: Say: 'the map shrinks by about a factor of p; the exact output side is given by the floor formula below.'
